By [[22 BBY/Legends|seven months]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] ''[[VCD987]]''<ref name="Count Dooku" /> undertook a '''mission to Drongar'''<ref name="Justiss DB">{{DB|character|kaijustiss|Justiss, Kai}}</ref> with a fresh detachment of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]], [[Sian Jeisel]], and [[Kai Justiss]]. En route, the Republic cruiser was ambushed by [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] Separatists loyal to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. With its engines disabled, Dooku and [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]] led the Quarren soldiers in a boarding action. After securing the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Bulq was ordered to slay the surviving clone troopers, cutting off reinforcements to [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]].<ref name="Count Dooku" />
